method: score(set)=n_U_carriers x expected beta-binomial entropy reduction after one label (prior from non-U firm evidence only). Retrospective reveal of top-K sets' labels; variant unlock via binomial-test proxy (background 0.1, alpha 0.05, min 3). Baselines: count-only, random (seed 1). K=1,2,5,10,20,50.
interpretation: Info-gain vs count-only %U-resolved: K=10 0.381 vs 0.381 (delta +0.000); K=50 0.537 vs 0.526 (delta +0.011).
caveats: Retrospective, not prospective; assumes catalogued variants transfer across lineages. Variant unlock is a binomial-test proxy for catomatic strict_unlock. If info-gain barely beats count-only, that is a valid negative result. Priors exclude U labels (no leakage).
supports: Value-of-information lab queue (novelty P-E15): prioritizes phenotyping by expected information per referral cleared.
